text:
Priya: Kickoff for our HW cohort with Lumenic (Edge SoC). NDA signed yesterday — thanks legal. Goal: run our two benchmark suites + latency SLO on their devkit and collect perf/accuracy deltas. Please confirm owners and any blockers.
Jordan: I can own the benchmark harness + result aggregation. Will open the PR for the harness template today.
Ethan: @Jordan noted. Infra questions: do we need 4x devkits with separate nodes, or a single multi-GPU rig? also need early build of the runtime image and kernel flags from partner.
Nora: I'll prepare the model artifacts and quant configs. Which families are we targeting for the initial runs? small/mid/large?
Priya: Start with Llama2-13B quantized as the main test, use 7B FP as a baseline. If that looks good we can expand.
Priya: High-level schedule: week1 = infra + onboarding + NDA checklist, week2 = run#1 throughput/batch sizing, week3 = run#2 latency/p95 + fallback behavior, week4 = analysis + partner readout. Keep cadence tight.
Ethan: Run command I'm planning to use (example):
```
python run_bench.py \
  --model redwood/llama2-13b-qat \
  --profile latency \
  --devkit /mnt/lumenic0 \
  --out results/lumenic_run1.json
```
We'll tag jobs with: lumenic-eap-2026
Nora: Dataset subset = evalset/core-1k.jsonl, seed=42. I'll upload to s3://redwood-eap/lumenic/ by EOD tomorrow and add a manifest.
Priya: Note from legal/partner: they want to keep numbers internal until we complete validation. No joint press or public benchmarking claims until both sides sign off (likely Dec window).
Jordan: Can we wire up automated regression alerts? Proposing thresholds: latency p95 < 150ms for the quant run, and throughput > 120 tokens/s baseline. If either fails, open a regression ticket and notify #eng-oncall. :ok_hand:
Priya: Action items summary: Ethan -> infra ticket #4321 (devkit provisioning + image), Nora -> upload artifacts, Jordan -> harness PR by Friday, Priya -> schedule partner readout Thu 11am PT. I'll follow up with calendar invites and a one-pager.
ciara-bot: Deploy job queued: infra-deploy/4321 started. Link: https://ci.redwood/builds/4321
Ethan: Ack. I'll post cluster access + kubeconfig path in #eng-infra and add credentials to vault at /secrets/eap/lumenic.
Priya: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for EAP status. Quick pulse check tomorrow 10am PT? :calendar:
